General Manager Job at Viabonam Corporate Services




        
    

        
        Viabonam Corporate Services - We help our Clients Simplify, re-energize, and Grow their businesses in Nigeria. Expanding the geographic footprints of our client’s business into Nigeria will always pose a risky and expensive proposition – the risks have not gone away, they’ve just shifted. That’s where we come in. We provide tailor-made solutions that drive businesses to success including everything required for a ‘genuine presence’ in Nigeria from company formation, tax-efficient corporate structuring, and full local business support from our offices in Nigeria. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: General Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	We are seeking an experienced, hands-on General Manager to take full responsibility for Paramount Furniture’s overall business performance, including production, sales, and operations.
	Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will lead the business with a strong focus on operational excellence, efficient manufacturing, and profitable growth across our retail, contract, and institutional sales channels.
	This is a senior leadership role requiring proven experience in general management within the furniture manufacturing industry.


You will be directly responsible for


	Running the factory to standard, managing output, quality, materials, and delivery timelines.
	Getting and driving sales across retail, corporate, hospitality contract, and institutional or developer channels.
	Setting and enforcing quality standards across materials, production, and finished goods.
	Recruiting, structuring, and managing teams across production, sales, and administration.
	Maintaining proper records, controls, and regular reporting to the Managing Director. Roles and Responsibilities include:
	Run factory operations to standard, managing output, materials, and delivery timelines.
	Set and enforce quality control standards across production, from incoming materials through finishing and final inspection before dispatch.
	Investigate quality failures, customer complaints, and returns, and put corrective measures in place.
	Drive sales across retail, corporate and hospitality contract, and institutional or developer channels.
	Recruit, structure, and manage teams across production, quality control, sales, and administration.
	Set and monitor targets across production output, quality and defect rates, sales revenue, and profitability.
	Negotiate major supplier, client, and contract terms.
	Maintain proper records, controls, and reporting systems across the business.
	Represent the business with clients, suppliers, and partners.
	Report regularly to the Managing Director on performance across all functions.


Requirements and Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree
	10+ years of experience, including a senior general management or business leadership role in furniture manufacturing or related industries.
	Proven track record owning full P&L responsibility across both production and commercial functions.
	Strong background in manufacturing or production operations, including materials management and output planning.
	Hands-on experience establishing and enforcing quality control systems in a production environment, including inspection standards, defect tracking, and corrective action.
	Strong background in sales leadership, ideally spanning retail, B2B contract, and institutional channels.
	Demonstrated ability to build and lead teams across multiple functions.
	Strong financial management and budgeting discipline.
	Working knowledge of the furniture and interiors market in Abuja and surrounding markets.
	Ability to work with minimal supervision.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Officer

Job Locations: Numan, Yola, Mubi, Adamawa

Role Summary
     

            
    




	Provide clinical assessment, diagnosis, treatment, referral and medical oversight for staff, riders and community patients; establish clinical protocols and support emergency medical decisions and health programmes.


Minimum Requirements


	Medical degree (MBBS or equivalent recognised medical qualification).
	Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in clinical practice or a closely related medical role.
	Current registration and practising licence with the appropriate Nigerian medical regulatory body.
	Strong primary-care, emergency assessment, clinical documentation and professional ethics.


Other Requirements:


	All applicants must be at least 18 years of age.
	All applicants must be ready and available to work in Adamawa State, Nigeria.
	All positions are full-time employment positions. Part-time or contract engagement may be considered on a case-by-case basis, subject to operational requirements and management approval.
	Applicants must provide accurate information and verifiable academic, professional, and employment records. Misrepresentation may lead to disqualification or termination of engagement.
	Applicants should demonstrate integrity, professionalism, reliability, teamwork, willingness to learn, and commitment to service delivery.
	Unless a role-specific requirement states otherwise, the minimum educational qualification for non-state-level positions is a Diploma/ND or equivalent relevant qualification.
	Applicants must possess the applicable current credentials (professional licences, registrations, or certifications) required to lawfully perform the role.


Employment Terms


	This postion is intended as full-time employment 
	Part-time or contract-based engagement may be considered on a case-by-case basis where the role, operational need, and candidate profile justify such an arrangement.
	Successful candidates may be required to work across assigned operational locations within Adamawa State and to participate in field activities where applicable.
	Working hours, reporting lines, compensation, benefits, probation, leave, and other employment conditions will be communicated to shortlisted candidates during the selection and offer process.


Remuneration & Benefits

Sales & Marketing Manager Job at Landgate investment Limited




        
    

        
        Landgate investment Limited - We offer you simplified, rewarding and secure property intensity. We make property investment accessible to everyone in a way that is simple, secure and high return on Investment {ROI}.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Sales & Marketing Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary 
     

            
    




	The Sales & Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing sales and marketing strategies that drive property sales, generate leads, increase revenue, and strengthen the company’s position in the real estate market.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement sales and marketing strategies to achieve company revenue targets.
	Lead, supervise, and motivate the sales and marketing team.
	Generate and manage leads through digital marketing, property listings, referrals, events, and other channels.
	Drive the sale and leasing of residential, commercial, and investment properties.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, investors, realtors, and business partners.
	Monitor market trends, competitor activities, property prices, and customer preferences.
	Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, websites, and other platforms.
	Coordinate property promotions, open houses, exhibitions, realtor engagements, and other marketing activities.
	Track sales performance, conversion rates, lead generation, and marketing ROI.
	Prepare regular sales and marketing reports for management.
	Ensure prospective clients receive accurate information about properties, pricing, payment plans, and investment opportunities.
	Negotiate with clients and support the team in closing property transactions.
	Collaborate with the Admin, Customer Service, Legal, Finance, and Project teams to ensure smooth transactions.
	Develop and maintain a database of prospects, clients, and business partners.
	Identify new business opportunities and strategic partnerships to expand the company’s customer base.
	Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with company policies and applicable regulations.
